faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about the DizzitUp ecosystem, services, and how we empower African MSMEs.
faq.popularSearches: Popular: How to sell? • DZY Token • Delivery
faq.supportDesc: Our support team and AI assistant Aminata are here to help you 24/7.

marketplace.a: DizzitUp is an all-in-one stablecoin-powered marketplace designed for the African continent. It allows the diaspora to support loved ones by paying for basic necessity products and services (healthcare, education, groceries) directly at the source.

marketplace.q: Is it available in my country?
marketplace.a: DizzitUp is designed to serve all 54 African countries, but available merchants, products, and services may vary by country. We are constantly expanding our partner network.

marketplace.q: How do I buy for a family member in another African country?
marketplace.a: Simply select the recipient's country and city, browse available local products, and pay. The merchant will receive the order and deliver it to your family member or provide pick-up details.

marketplace.q: Do I need an account to browse or buy?
marketplace.a: You can browse without an account, but you will need to register a simple user account to complete a purchase and track your order history.
Depending on the merchant, products can be picked up locally or delivered to the recipient's doorstep. You'll see the delivery options on the product page.

marketplace.q: What happens if my order is not delivered?
marketplace.a: DizzitUp provides transaction monitoring. If a merchant fails to deliver, our support team will mediate, and you are protected by our refund policies for unfulfilled orders.

business.q: How do I sell on DizzitUp?
business.a: Click 'Register Business' in the footer or menu. Registration is free. Once verified, you can list your products and reach customers globally.

business.q: What documents are needed to register a business?
business.a: You'll need basic business registration documents (KYB) and a valid ID for the business owner. This ensures a safe marketplace for all users.

business.q: How long does merchant verification take?
business.a: Verification typically takes 24-48 hours. Our team reviews your documents to ensure compliance with local and international standards.

business.q: How do settlements and payouts work for merchants?
business.a: We support multiple settlement methods: Mobile Money, Bank accounts, Stablecoins (USDT, USDC), and DZY tokens. You choose your preferred method in your Merchant Portal.

business.q: When do I receive my money?
business.a: Settlements can be processed daily or weekly depending on your country and preferred method. Blockchain-based payouts are often the fastest.

fintech.a: DZYwallet is your secure digital gateway to the DizzitUp ecosystem. It handles multi-currency assets and supports low-cost transactions within the platform.

fintech.q: How do I recover access to my wallet?
fintech.a: Your DZYwallet is secured by advanced cryptography. If you lose access, you can recover it through the recovery methods you set up during registration (email/social).
DZY is our platform's utility token. It powers instant settlements, lowers transaction fees, and provides rewards to users for their participation in the ecosystem.
We use a hybrid approach to ensure both security and ease of use, utilizing the Crossmint MPC architecture for institutional-grade safety without the complexity of phrase management.

fintech.q: Can I cash out to bank or mobile money?
fintech.a: Yes! DizzitUp supports 'off-ramps' allowing you to convert your digital assets or earnings into local currency via Bank Transfer or Mobile Money in supported countries.

security.a: DizzitUp uses bank-grade encryption (TLS 1.3), AES-256 storage, and blockchain-based Proof-of-Settlement to ensure every transaction is safe and immutable.

security.q: Who do I contact if something goes wrong?
security.a: You can reach us 24/7 via the 'Ask Aminata' chat, or email us directly at support@dizzitup.com. We typically respond within minutes.

security.q: How do I report a bug or issue?
security.a: Please use the 'Report Issue' link in your profile menu or contact support directly with details of the problem and your account information.
